chains.title: GATA3 binds the risk allele more strongly at the TOX3 enhancer

links.claim: GATA3 binds the alt T allele of rs4784227 more strongly than the ref C allele in vitro: in QBiC-SELEX group G010 (GATA family), GATA3 has its own passing model with the same positive sign as the group best model (GATA3 z 10.91, effect +0.283, alt binds more). I choose GATA3 within the GATA family because it is by far the highest-expressed GATA member in MCF7 (346.04 TPM) and because 5 ENCODE GATA3 ChIP-seq peaks in MCF7 contain the variant (E20), establishing GATA3 occupancy at this element in the case cell type, although not allele specificity.
rs4784227 lies in the dELS EH38E3180851 / ENSR16_9QTBS enhancer with active chromatin marks, so allele-specific GATA3 binding could change enhancer activity; the site is not conserved (GERP -2).
The element is best linked to TOX3: TOX3 is the nearest protein-coding gene and the top Open Targets L2G target (0.92-0.96) in breast cancer credible sets.

MCF7 is a luminal breast cancer line with very high GATA3 expression (346.04 TPM), and GATA3 ChIP-seq peaks in MCF7 contain the variant, making GATA3 occupancy at this enhancer in this cell type directly supported. The cCRE annotation itself is ENCODE-wide rather than MCF7-specific.

The strongest breast cancer GWAS associations list T as the risk allele, and GATA3 is a breast cancer lineage factor. If GATA3 binding at T changes TOX3 enhancer output, this could contribute to breast cancer risk; the direction of TOX3 change is not established by SELEX or by occupancy alone.

predictions: GATA3 ChIP in MCF7 will show occupancy at rs4784227 (already supported by E20) and allele-specific GATA3 ChIP will show stronger occupancy on the T allele than on the C allele.
GATA3 knockdown or CRISPRi will alter rs4784227 enhancer activity and/or TOX3 expression in MCF7.
The allele-specific GATA3 effect will be stronger in GATA3-high breast cancer cells than in GATA3-low cells.
falsified_if: GATA3 does not occupy the rs4784227 element in MCF7, contrary to the E20 ChIP peaks.
GATA3 binding is not allele-specific, or the T allele binds less GATA3.
GATA3 knockdown does not affect the enhancer or TOX3.

The breast cancer association is explained by a linked causal variant in LD, or rs4784227 is a passenger in a locus where another variant drives the effect.

chains.title: MAFG binds the risk allele more strongly at the TOX3 enhancer

links.claim: MAFG binds the alt T allele of rs4784227 more strongly than the ref C allele in vitro: in QBiC-SELEX group G012, the MAFG own model is the best model (z 71.57, effect +2.788, alt binds more; site strength ref 97.6th to alt 100.0th percentile). I choose MAFG within the shared bZIP group because it has the strongest own-model signal in the group and is expressed in MCF7 (8.48 TPM), but no MAFG ChIP-seq peak in MCF7 contains the variant (E18; absence can also mean no MAFG experiment in that biosample). Thus the cellular occupancy claim is not established.

rs4784227 lies in the distal enhancer-like cCRE EH38E3180851 / ENSR16_9QTBS enhancer (dELS; DNase z 4.2, H3K27ac z 6.1), so allele-specific MAFG binding could alter enhancer activity. The site is not deeply conserved (GERP -2), so the enhancer annotation rather than conservation carries this part of the claim.

The variant-bearing enhancer is most plausibly linked to TOX3: TOX3 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 17.5 kb, and Open Targets L2G assigns TOX3 0.92-0.96 in breast cancer credible sets. CASC16 is also at the locus, but the strongest L2G target is TOX3.

MCF7 is the supplied breast cancer expression context, MAFG is expressed there at 8.48 TPM, and the element is an ENCODE dELS. However, the cCRE z-scores are maxima over ENCODE biosamples, and no MCF7 MAFG ChIP peak at the variant is reported.

The strongest breast cancer GWAS associations list T as the risk allele at this locus, and GWAS/L2G evidence connects the locus to TOX3. If MAFG occupancy at the T allele changes TOX3 enhancer output, this is a candidate route to breast cancer risk; SELEX alone does not establish whether MAFG activates or represses the enhancer.

predictions: MAFG ChIP in MCF7 or breast epithelial cells will show occupancy at rs4784227 and stronger MAFG signal on the T allele than on the C allele, despite the current absence of an ENCODE MCF7 MAFG peak.
MAFG knockdown or overexpression will change activity of the rs4784227 enhancer reporter and/or TOX3 expression in a TOX3-linked manner.
GATA3 will occupy this element in MCF7 but MAFG, not GATA3, will be the allele-specific factor at rs4784227.
falsified_if: MAFG does not occupy the rs4784227 element in breast cancer cells.
Allele-specific MAFG binding is absent or opposite to the QBiC-SELEX prediction.
The rs4784227 element has no allele-dependent enhancer activity and no effect on TOX3 in a relevant cell type.

chains.title: MAFK is the expressed bZIP factor whose binding is altered

links.claim: MAFK binds the alt T allele of rs4784227 more strongly than the ref C allele in vitro: in QBiC-SELEX group G012, MAFK has its own passing model with the same positive sign as the group best model (MAFK z 48.84, alt binds more). I choose MAFK within the shared bZIP group because it is the highest-expressed group member in MCF7 (16.96 TPM). No MAFK ChIP-seq peak in MCF7 contains the variant; one MAFK peak in HepG2 does (E19).

The variant sits in the distal enhancer-like cCRE EH38E3180851 / ENSR16_9QTBS enhancer (dELS; DNase z 4.2, H3K27ac z 6.1), so an allele-specific MAFK binding change could affect enhancer activity; the site is not conserved (GERP -2).
The enhancer's best-supported target is TOX3: TOX3 is 17.5 kb away and is the top Open Targets L2G gene (0.92-0.96) across breast cancer credible sets.

MCF7 is a breast cancer expression context in which MAFK is well expressed (16.96 TPM), and the element is annotated as a dELS. The ENCODE cCRE z-scores are not MCF7-specific, and the only reported MAFK ChIP peak containing the variant is in HepG2, not MCF7.

The strongest breast cancer GWAS associations list T as the risk allele, and the locus is linked to TOX3. If MAFK binding at the T allele alters TOX3 enhancer output, this could contribute to breast cancer risk; the SELEX data do not determine activation versus repression.

predictions: MAFK ChIP in MCF7 or breast cells will show allele-specific occupancy at rs4784227, stronger on T.
MAFK knockdown will alter the rs4784227 enhancer reporter or TOX3 expression, while MAFG knockdown will have little effect at this site.
The MAFK effect will be detectable in a cell type where MAFK is the dominant small MAF at this element.
falsified_if: MAFK does not occupy the locus or shows no allele-specific binding.
MAFG, not MAFK, is the factor whose knockdown changes enhancer activity or TOX3 expression.
The element has no allele-dependent activity in breast cancer cells.

chains.title: NFATC3 represses the enhancer and the risk allele reduces its binding

links.claim: NFATC3 binds the ref C allele more strongly than the alt T allele in vitro: in QBiC-SELEX group G026 (Rel family), NFATC3 has its own passing model with the group's negative sign (NFATC3 z -4.28, alt binds less). I choose NFATC3 within the Rel group because it is the highest-expressed Rel member in MCF7 (9.54 TPM). No NFATC3 ChIP evidence at this variant is supplied, and the NFATC3 SELEX signal is near the gate.

The variant is in the dELS EH38E3180851 / ENSR16_9QTBS enhancer, so allele-specific NFATC3 occupancy could modulate enhancer activity; the element is annotated as active chromatin but the site itself is not conserved (GERP -2).
The enhancer is best linked to TOX3 by proximity and by Open Targets L2G (TOX3 0.92-0.96).

MCF7 expresses NFATC3 at 9.54 TPM, higher than NFATC2 and NFATC4, so NFATC3 is the most plausible Rel family member in this expression context; the ENCODE cCRE z-scores are not MCF7-specific, and no NFATC3 ChIP at the variant is supplied.

The strongest breast cancer GWAS associations list T as the risk allele. If NFATC3 represses the TOX3 enhancer, then the risk T allele's lower NFATC3 binding would derepress TOX3; this is a distinct direction of TOX3 change from the activator models. The repressor/derepression assumption is not directly supported.

predictions: NFATC3 ChIP will show stronger binding on the C allele than on the T allele at rs4784227.
NFATC3 knockdown will increase rs4784227 enhancer activity and/or TOX3 expression if NFATC3 is repressive.
The effect will be seen in MCF7 or other breast cells with detectable NFATC3.
falsified_if: NFATC3 does not occupy the locus in breast cancer cells.
NFATC3 binds the T allele more strongly, opposite to the QBiC-SELEX sign.
NFATC3 knockdown does not change enhancer activity or TOX3 expression.
